body:
## Problem

Three test failures today were red on an operator's macOS checkout and green in
Linux CI. None was a product defect; all three were tests asserting against the
shape of the host filesystem rather than against the code under test.

- #532 (fixed on `fix/macos-realpath-test-comparisons`) —
  `packages/context-handoff/test/continue-cli-support.mjs:38` handed a raw
  `mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), …))` path to a subprocess as its `cwd`. On macOS
  `tmpdir()` is `/var/folders/…`, a symlink to `/private/var/folders/…`. The
  child's own `process.cwd()` reports the canonical form, so
  `resolveHandoffDirs()` (`packages/context-handoff/lib/paths.mjs:23`, default
  `cwd = process.cwd()`) printed `/private/var/…` while the test built its
  expectation from `/var/…`. `assert.equal` on `payload.content_path` failed.
- #535 (open) — two repo-wide walkers skipped worktrees by hardcoded directory
  NAME, descended into `.claude/worktrees/`, and read a dead branch's files.
- #535, site 2 — the same walk in `@adlc/tickets` flipped a rail's verdict
  depending on whether the operator had worktrees on disk.

The unifying defect is not realpath and is not worktree naming. It is that
**`npm test` green on Linux does not mean `npm test` green on the platform the
maintainers actually develop on**, so this class is only ever discovered by an
operator hitting it, one instance at a time.

## Why the existing coverage does not catch it

`.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs the whole suite on `ubuntu-latest` only.
`.github/workflows/ticket-store-platform.yml` DOES run a
`[ubuntu, macos, windows] x [18, 20, 22]` matrix — but scoped to
`npm test --workspace @adlc/tickets`, one package out of 31. Every other
package's tests have never run on macOS in CI.

## Measured latent exposure

Static scan of tracked test/harness files (`git ls-files '*.mjs'` filtered to
`test/`, `cli-test/`, `adapter-test/`, `*-support.mjs`):

- 533 test/harness files.
- 834 `mkdtempSync` call sites take the raw, non-canonical path; only 44 wrap it
  in `realpathSync`.
- 144 files both take a raw temp path AND launch a subprocess with a `cwd` —
  the exact configuration that produced #532.

Those 144 pass today only because they do not happen to compare an absolute path
the child produced against one the parent built. #532 shows what happens the
moment a new assertion of that shape is added: the author cannot see the bug
because CI is green.

## Fix

Two layers, in this order.

**1. Run the full suite on macOS in CI (primary).** This is what makes "CI green"
mean "green on a maintainer's machine", and it closes the whole class — the
realpath sub-class, the nested-checkout sub-class of #535, and the next one
nobody has named yet. `ticket-store-platform.yml` is the working precedent for
a matrix job in this repo; extend that pattern to `node scripts/run-tests.mjs`.
Keep Linux as the required gate and decide explicitly whether macOS blocks merge
or reports only — but it must be visible on every PR, not on a schedule.

**2. Canonicalize temp roots at the source (deterministic complement).** A CI
job catches an instance after it is written; a shared helper prevents it. Export
one `mkdtempRealSync(prefix)` that returns
`realpathSync(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), prefix)))`, migrate the 144 at-risk
harnesses to it, and add a guard test that fails on a bare `mkdtempSync` in a
file that also passes a `cwd` to a child process. Scope the guard to that
intersection rather than all 834 sites: the narrow rule is the one with no false
positives, and the broad sweep is churn that buys nothing for the ~690 sites that
never hand the path to another process.

Layer 2 alone is insufficient — it would not have caught either #535 site.
Layer 1 alone is insufficient — it lets the bug be written and merged, then
found. Both are wanted.

## Acceptance criteria

1. The full suite runs on macOS on every PR.
   Verify: `gh pr checks <pr>` on a PR against this branch lists a macOS job
   running `node scripts/run-tests.mjs`, and it reports 54/54 segments.
2. The macOS job actually fails on this class.
   Verify: revert `packages/context-handoff/test/continue-cli-support.mjs` to the
   bare `mkdtempSync` form, push, and confirm the macOS job goes red while the
   Linux job stays green. Restore afterwards. (Plant the defect — do not infer
   the job works from a passing run.)
3. A shared `mkdtempRealSync` helper exists and the 144 at-risk harnesses use it.
   Verify: the scan in "Measured latent exposure" reports 0 files in the
   raw-temp-AND-subprocess-cwd intersection.
4. The guard rejects a newly written instance.
   Verify: a self-test in the guard's own test file plants a fixture with a bare
   `mkdtempSync` plus a subprocess `cwd` and asserts the guard flags it.
5. No behaviour change on Linux.
   Verify: `env -u ADLC_TICKET node scripts/run-tests.mjs` still exits 0 with
   54/54 segments on ubuntu.

## Notes for the builder

- `.github/workflows/**` is railed by completed tickets T37/T38, so any change
  there needs a cross-model attestation recorded before the gate goes green.
  Budget for that; it is expected, not a regression.
- Windows is deliberately not proposed here. macOS is where the maintainers work
  and where all three instances surfaced; adding Windows to a 54-segment suite is
  a separate cost/benefit call and belongs in its own ticket.

## Out of scope

The #532 fix itself (already landed on `fix/macos-realpath-test-comparisons`)
and the #535 walker fix (already open). This ticket is the defense that stops the
fourth instance, not a re-fix of the first three.
title: Run the full test suite on macOS in CI, and canonicalize temp roots at the source
